A feline humanoid with short, tufted, ginger orange fur and white patches on the paws. Slanted, mischievous, emerald green eyes. Appears as a mature adolescent. Lean, agile build wearing a purple and yellow street-wear vest with oversized pockets. Possesses pointed cat ears, a long, flexible ginger orange tail, and three claws per hand.
BODY COLOR: ginger orange
